# Architecture decision records

One file per decision: context, decision, consequences. Never rewrite an
accepted ADR. Supersede it with a new one and link both ways.

The table is generated from the ADR files' titles and statuses on `main` after
every merge (ADR 0213): add the ADR file, not a row. Do not edit the table.
